data.question: Penduduk miskin di Sumatera Utara berapa?

value.raw_question: Penduduk miskin di Sumatera Utara berapa?

value.sql:
SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.kode, periode;

SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.periode, SUM(T3.nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T3 ON T1.kode = T3.kode_provinsi
JOIN indikator AS T2 ON T3.kode_indikator = T2.kode
WHERE T3.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T3.periode = :periode
  AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.nama, T2.periode
ORDER BY T3.nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

GROUP BY provinsi.kode
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM provinsi AS T1

LEFT JOIN (SELECT kode_indikator, periode, nilai FROM nilai_indikator WHERE kode_indikator = :indikator AND periode = :periode AND kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)) AS T3 ON T2.kode_indikator = T3.kode_indikator AND T2.periode = T3.periode
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND T2.periode = :periode

GROUP BY T1.nama, T2.periode
ORDER BY T2.nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
